subject.title: fix(tui): deduplicate assistant messages across sessions.changed reload

question: Should OpenClaw accept this TUI runId surrender contract for `sessions.changed` `new`/`reset` reloads, where finalized surrendered runs suppress all late finals and in-flight surrendered runs can still render displayable finals?
rationale: The patch is narrow and well-proven, but it intentionally changes cross-reload session/run-state behavior and should be accepted by a human owner before merge.

options.title: Accept the surrender contract
options.body: Merge after required checks because the event-handler boundary avoids ChatLog text heuristics and covers the reported duplicate-reply race.

options.title: Ask for native visual proof first
options.body: Pause merge until a maintainer or contributor captures a TUI-visible external-channel run showing one assistant reply after the reload race.

options.title: Rework finalized-run suppression
options.body: Require a different contract if maintainers do not want finalized surrendered runs to suppress all later finals after history reload.

recommendation.title: Accept the surrender contract
recommendation.body: Merge after required checks because the event-handler boundary avoids ChatLog text heuristics and covers the reported duplicate-reply race.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the live assignee for this maintainer-review decision.
